titleEs: D4builds.gg vs D4 Planner — sharing community o planning individual
titleEn: D4builds.gg vs D4 Planner — community sharing or individual planning
descriptionEs: Ambos son build planners. D4builds.gg es plataforma de community sharing con voting; D4 Planner es herramienta de planning individual con UI más técnica.
descriptionEn: Both are build planners. D4builds.gg is a community-sharing platform with voting; D4 Planner is an individual planning tool with more technical UI.
verdictEs: D4builds.gg para discover builds existentes y validar ideas ante community. D4 Planner para planning iterativo en tu own time sin necesidad de publish. Complementarios.
verdictEn: D4builds.gg to discover existing builds and validate ideas with the community. D4 Planner for iterative planning on your own time without needing to publish. Complementary.

useCases.labelEs: Discover builds populares filterable por clase
useCases.labelEn: Discover popular builds filterable by class
useCases.reasonEs: D4builds.gg tiene voting comunitario y filters por season/class/popularity. D4 Planner no tiene catálogo browseable.
useCases.reasonEn: D4builds.gg has community voting and filters by season/class/popularity. D4 Planner has no browseable catalog.

useCases.reasonEs: D4 Planner permite abrir dos builds simultáneamente para comparar stat diff. D4builds.gg requiere abrir builds en tabs separados.
useCases.reasonEn: D4 Planner allows opening two builds simultaneously to compare stat diffs. D4builds.gg requires opening builds in separate tabs.

useCases.reasonEs: D4builds.gg tiene función Fork built-in — copias un build, modificas, publish opcional. D4 Planner requiere recrear desde scratch.
useCases.reasonEn: D4builds.gg has built-in Fork — copy a build, modify, optionally publish. D4 Planner requires recreating from scratch.

useCases.labelEs: Planning privado sin presión de publish
useCases.reasonEs: D4 Planner es para tu workflow personal sin community visibility. D4builds.gg, aunque permite draft, está culturalmente oriented a publish.
useCases.reasonEn: D4 Planner is for your personal workflow without community visibility. D4builds.gg, although it allows drafts, is culturally oriented to publish.

useCases.labelEs: Validation comunitaria de tu build idea
useCases.labelEn: Community validation of your build idea
useCases.reasonEs: D4builds.gg te da feedback via votes y comments. D4 Planner es self-contained sin community engagement.
useCases.reasonEn: D4builds.gg gives feedback via votes and comments. D4 Planner is self-contained without community engagement.
